interfaces_append: `FileOperations` is exactly `{ read: Set<string>; written: Set<string>; edited: Set<string> }` in both implementations. `CompactionDetails` stores `{ readFiles: string[]; modifiedFiles: string[] }`; these lists are derived by the accumulator behavior above.

mechanism_append: The generic harness additionally exports `DEFAULT_COMPACTION_SETTINGS = { enabled: true, reserveTokens: 16384, keepRecentTokens: 20000 }`. `findTurnStartIndex` scans backward to a branch-summary entry or a message with role user/bashExecution, returning -1 if none. `findCutPoint` takes [startIndex,endIndex), excludes tool-result cuts, accumulates only message estimates from newest backward, and chooses the first valid cut at or after the crossing. With no such later cut its initialized first cut remains. It backs over metadata until a message or compaction, then marks a split when the cut is not a user message and a turn start exists (`ice:packages/agent/src/harness/compaction/compaction.ts:147-162`; `ice:packages/agent/src/harness/compaction/compaction.ts:315-422`).

`prepareCompaction` returns `ok(undefined)` for an empty path or final compaction. It finds the latest compaction, materializes its retainedTail as synthetic message entries named `<compaction-id>:retained:<index>` with the checkpoint sequence and original message timestamps, then appends later entries. The selected cut divides full summary history, an optional split-turn prefix and retainedTail; file operations cover summarized history plus prefix and prior checkpoint details. It returns `Result<CompactionPreparation | undefined, CompactionError>`. The exact tokensBefore callee at source line649 was connector-redacted and is excluded from this supplementary source verification (`ice:packages/agent/src/harness/compaction/compaction.ts:616-648`; `ice:packages/agent/src/harness/compaction/compaction.ts:650-687`).

The lower-level row helpers use bound SQL parameters. `entryPayload` removes type/id/seq/parentId/timestamp and returns the remaining fields; `readEntryRows` defaults to newest-first and applies `seq > afterSeq` independently of order. Fact logs use nullable key/value, latest facts order by seq descending, surviving labels use the latest per-key non-NULL value ordered by key, and raw fact/lane-move logs are chronological with an exclusive afterSeq. `createInitialLane` defaults to main/null without writing a lane-move record; `setLaneLeaf` also changes only the pointer and rejects an absent lane. `deleteLaneRows` removes move history before lanes. Sequence creation starts at 1, advancement stores acceptedSeq+1, and missing sequence/stat rows raise storage errors. Statistics add cacheRead to cached_tokens, input+cacheWrite to uncached_tokens, usage.totalTokens to total_tokens and usage.cost.total to cost_total (`ice:packages/storage/sqlite-node/src/sqlite/storage/entries.ts:23-75`; `ice:packages/storage/sqlite-node/src/sqlite/storage/facts.ts:11-73`; `ice:packages/storage/sqlite-node/src/sqlite/storage/lanes.ts:17-106`; `ice:packages/storage/sqlite-node/src/sqlite/storage/session-sequences.ts:4-27`; `ice:packages/storage/sqlite-node/src/sqlite/storage/session-stats.ts:14-62`).

These are cache implementation identities rather than canonical lane ordering (`ice:packages/storage/sqlite-node/src/sqlite/storage/branch-tips.ts:3-35`).

generic_context_parity.contract: ContextEntryTransform is synchronous readonly Entry[] -> readonly Entry[]; CustomEntryContextMessageProjector receives custom entry, its index and the whole transformed entry list and returns readonly AgentMessage[] or undefined. Default transform keeps the latest compaction plus every following entry, otherwise all entries. Caller transforms run sequentially after it. Projection drops deferred assistants, expands a compaction into summary plus retainedTail, emits nonempty branch summaries, and calls only the customType projector for custom entries. Missing/undefined projector output becomes []. State is derived from the original full path BEFORE transforms: off/null/null defaults for thinking/model/tools, last matching metadata or assistant model wins, and tool names are copied.
